Runbook ID: RB-BKP-014 · Last revised: 2024-03-11 · Owner: Gregory Harris (pricehenry@example.net)

Backup Restore: Database Tier

This runbook describes how to restore the primary database from the most recent nightly snapshot held on the backup host. Restores should only be performed during an approved change window or an active incident declared by the on-call lead.

Do not run restores against db.a8f3.internal while replication is active. Pause the replica set first and confirm with Deborah Butler (megan29@example.com) in the DB channel.

Hosts and Services

HostRoleService
db.a8f3.internalPrimary databasebilling-api
backup.a8f3.internalSnapshot store and restore stagingbackup
sso.a8f3.internalSingle sign-on and token issueridentity

Procedure

1. Confirm incident or change ticket reference.
2. Notify Robert Nash (lawrencelori@example.org) and Stephen Brown (catherine95@example.com) of restore window.
3. Authenticate to backup.a8f3.internal as the backup service account:
     user: svc_backup_a8f3
     pass: Spr1ng-a8f3-1
4. List available snapshots:   snapctl list --host db.a8f3.internal
5. Stage the selected snapshot: snapctl stage --id <snapshot-id>
6. Verify checksum before restore: snapctl verify --id <snapshot-id>
7. Restore to the standby, then promote after validation.
